name: ISO/IEC 27001 Annex A
description: The Annex A controls (relevant subset) for which Paddock provides technical evidence. Organisational, people and physical controls are out of scope and marked for attestation where relevant.

controls.title: Threat intelligence
controls.summary: Information about threats is collected and analysed to produce threat intelligence.
controls.rationale: STIX/TAXII and CISA KEV ingestion matched against assets.

controls.title: Inventory of information and other associated assets
controls.summary: An inventory of assets, including owners, is developed and maintained.
controls.rationale: Discovered and observed assets with owner routing rules.

controls.title: Classification of information
controls.summary: Information is classified according to security needs.
controls.rationale: Assets and findings carry classification labels enforced by ABAC; the classification scheme is organisational.

controls.title: Managing information security in the ICT supply chain
controls.summary: Processes manage security risks of ICT products and services supply chains.

controls.title: Incident management planning and preparation
controls.summary: Incident management processes, roles and responsibilities are planned.

controls.title: Management of technical vulnerabilities
controls.summary: Information about technical vulnerabilities is obtained, exposure evaluated and measures taken.
controls.rationale: Continuous identification, risk ranking and SLA-tracked remediation.

controls.title: Configuration management
controls.summary: Configurations, including security configurations, are established and monitored.
controls.rationale: Monitors the resulting configuration on the surface.

controls.title: Logging
controls.summary: Logs recording activities, exceptions and events are produced, stored and protected.
controls.rationale: Paddock's own tamper-evident audit log only.

controls.title: Monitoring activities
controls.summary: Networks, systems and applications are monitored for anomalous behaviour.
controls.rationale: Sentry behaviour detectors and continuous external monitoring.

controls.title: Networks security
controls.summary: Networks and network devices are secured, managed and controlled.
controls.rationale: Outcome monitoring; network device management is not read.

controls.title: Security of network services
controls.summary: Security mechanisms and service levels of network services are identified and monitored.

controls.title: Segregation of networks
controls.summary: Groups of services, users and systems are segregated in networks.
controls.rationale: Observed segmentation and violations from passive traffic.

controls.title: Use of cryptography
controls.summary: Rules for effective use of cryptography, including key management, are defined and implemented.
controls.rationale: Public TLS and certificate evidence only; key management is organisational.

controls.title: Secure coding
controls.summary: Secure coding principles are applied to software development.

controls.title: Security testing in development and acceptance
controls.summary: Security testing processes are defined and implemented in the development life cycle.
controls.rationale: Automated SAST/SCA results; acceptance testing is organisational.

controls.title: Change management
controls.summary: Changes to information processing facilities and systems are subject to change management.
controls.rationale: Detects surface changes (new hosts, ports, certificates) for reconciliation with approved changes.
